prompt_text: What is the best AI video ad maker?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single “best” AI video ad maker for everyone — the right choice depends on your goals (platform, format, length), budget, creative control, and whether you need human-presenter avatars or purely animated/text-based ads. Below are top options by use-case, with their strengths to help you choose.

Top picks and when to use them
- Synthesia / HeyGen / Colossyan
  - Best if you want realistic AI human presenters speaking your script.
  - Strengths: multilingual AI presenters, natural voices, fast turnaround, good for explainer/product pitch ads.
- Promo.com / Shakr / Motionbox
  - Best for short, high-converting social ads and e‑commerce video templates.
  - Strengths: platform-optimized templates, large stock asset libraries, simple drag-and-drop, A/B variant support.
- Pictory / Lumen5 / Designs.ai
  - Best for turning blog posts/scripts into short, polished ad videos.
  - Strengths: automated scene creation, stock clips & captions, quick repurposing of long-form content into ads.
- InVideo / Clipchamp / VEED
  - Best for flexible, template-driven ad creation with good manual editing options.
  - Strengths: templates, text-to-video, stock media, captioning and simple effects — good balance of automation and control.
- Runway / CapCut (with AI features)
  - Best if you need more advanced generative or creative editing (background replacement, generative fill).
  - Strengths: advanced AI editing tools, suited for creative/viral ad formats.
- Jasper + a video editor / AdCreative.ai (pair)
  - If you want AI to generate multiple ad variations (copy, headlines, CTAs) and then produce video variations, use copy-generation tools plus a video maker for scale.

How to choose
1. Define platform & format: Instagram/TikTok (vertical, short) vs YouTube (longer).
2. Presenter vs visuals: Do you want a real-looking presenter? Choose Synthesia/HeyGen. Need stock clips and motion text? Choose Promo/Pictory.
3. Languages & voices: For multi-language campaigns, prioritize tools with good TTS and avatar language support.
4. Speed vs control: Fully automated tools are faster; manual editors give more polish.
5. Budget & scale: If you want dozens of variants, ensure the tool supports bulk rendering or an API.
6. Brand consistency: Look for brand kits, templates, and custom fonts/colors.

Practical testing advice
- Produce 3–5 variants per creative and A/B test (thumbnail, hook, CTA).
- Use platform-optimized specs and captions for social.
- Track performance per variant and iterate quickly.

Quick recommendations by common needs
- E-commerce social ads (fast templates + stock): Promo.com or Shakr
- Human presenter ads (professional-looking speaking avatar): Synthesia or HeyGen
- Convert blog/articles/scripts to snappy ads: Pictory or Lumen5
- Best balance of editing control + AI: InVideo or VEED
- Advanced/generative editing: Runway

If you tell me your platform (TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, YouTube), budget, whether you need an on-screen presenter, and how many ads you want to produce per month, I can recommend the single best option and a short workflow to get started.
session_note: run_channel caveat: API results can differ from logged-in consumer apps, no memory, no personalization.
